key.name: position
key.summary: Island position on screen

key.name: margin
key.summary: Distance from the screen edge (px)

key.name: width
key.summary: Minimum island width (px), 0 sizes it to the content, below 0 tightens the resting island

key.name: height
key.summary: Minimum island height (px), 0 sizes it to the content

key.name: art-size
key.summary: Cover art size in the resting island (px)

key.name: art-size-expanded
key.summary: Cover art size in the expanded island (px)

key.name: art-shape
key.summary: Cover art shape, auto is round when resting and rounded square when expanded

key.name: art-border
key.summary: Frame around the cover art

key.name: art-compact
key.summary: Show the cover art in the resting island

key.name: art-spin
key.summary: Spin the cover like a vinyl record while playing

key.name: text-width
key.summary: Maximum width of the title text (px), longer titles are ellipsized

key.name: expand-on
key.summary: What opens the details view

key.name: eq-style
key.summary: Shape of the music visualizer

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Visualizer color (#rrggbb)

key.name: show-volume
key.summary: Show volume and brightness changes (replaces GNOME pop-up)

key.name: show-battery
key.summary: Show charger plugged/unplugged

key.name: show-recording
key.summary: Show screen recording timer

key.name: show-bluetooth
key.summary: Show Bluetooth devices connecting

key.name: show-progress
key.summary: Show download and file copy progress

key.name: show-notifications
key.summary: Show desktop and app notifications in the island

key.name: hide-native-banners
key.summary: Hide default GNOME notification pop-up banners

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide the island when a fullscreen app or video is active
